hooks.command: [ -z "$PR_REVIEW_CHILD" ] || exit 0; p=$(cat); url=$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -r 'select(.tool_response.gitOperation.pr.action == "created") | .tool_response.gitOperation.pr.url // empty'); [ -n "$url" ] || exit 0; cd "$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -r '.cwd')" || exit 0; out=$(PR_REVIEW_CHILD=1 claude -p --setting-sources user --permission-mode auto "/code-review xhigh $url" 2>&1); printf 'The background review of %s finished. Its findings:\n%s\n' "$url" "$out" >&2; exit 2
